clue.text: About hundred in expanded team at airport

indicators.note: in tells us the first two pieces sit inside the word for expanded

blocks.note: round means about, as in going round or about
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
grew means got bigger

explanation.surface: A sports team grows by a hundred members ahead of a trip through the airport.
explanation.definitionFit: The ground crew are the staff who service, fuel and load aircraft on the tarmac between flights.

clue.text: Once more missing a profit

indicators.note: missing says the following letter is taken away from the word for once more

blocks.note: once more means again
the letter a, which is removed

explanation.surface: A business fails, yet again, to turn a profit.
explanation.definitionFit: A gain is money earned over cost, the same thing as a profit in trading.

clue.text: Company up above leading American ink producer

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top
in a down entry, above places one piece over the next in the column

blocks.note: CO is the usual abbreviation for company
top means leading, first in rank
US stands for the United States, so American

explanation.surface: Reads like a description of a US firm heading the market in printer ink.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'ink producer' sounds industrial, but it is the sea creature that squirts ink to escape predators.
explanation.definitionFit: An octopus releases a cloud of dark ink when threatened, so it is a natural producer of the stuff.

clue.text: Giant with terrible hate asks after knight? Not very good

indicators.note: terrible suggests something badly mangled, so the letters are rearranged
after places the following pieces later in the answer than the chess abbreviation

blocks.note: N is the chess notation for a knight
an ogre is a giant of folklore
these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A monstrous giant asks after a knight with hateful intent, a fairy-tale scene judged mediocre.
explanation.walkthrough: In chess notation K is the king, so the knight is N.
explanation.definitionFit: No great shakes is an informal idiom for something unremarkable or mediocre.

clue.text: Dog appearing to be otherwise in animated graphics?

indicators.note: in puts the word for otherwise inside the abbreviation for animated graphics

blocks.note: or means otherwise, as in do it or else
CGI is computer-generated imagery, the graphics of modern animation

explanation.surface: A dog in a cartoon looks different from how it does in real life.
explanation.definitionFit: The corgi is a short-legged Welsh herding breed, famously kept by Queen Elizabeth II.

clue.text: Destroy order, losing time after time

indicators.note: losing says a letter is dropped from the word for order
after puts the shortened word behind the period of history

blocks.note: an era is a period of time
a dictate is an order or command
T is the abbreviation for time, the letter that is dropped

explanation.surface: An instruction to wreck things, with no time wasted over it.
explanation.definitionFit: To eradicate is to wipe out completely, root and branch, so to destroy.

clue.text: Speaker's manner, one entitled to succeed

indicators.note: a speaker's version is how a word comes out when spoken, not how it is spelt

blocks.note: an air is a manner or bearing, as in an air of confidence

explanation.surface: Suggests the manner of the Speaker of the Commons and a successor waiting in the wings.
explanation.walkthrough: The H of the answer is silent, so it is said exactly like the word for manner.
explanation.definitionFit: An heir is the person in line to inherit a title or estate on the holder's death.

clue.text: Incitement to riot? No small issue

indicators.note: no small means the abbreviation for small is removed from the phrase before it

blocks.note: sedition is stirring people up against authority
S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: Incitement to riot is said to be a serious matter, no small issue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No small issue' reads as one phrase meaning a big deal; split it so 'issue' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An edition is one issue of a newspaper or magazine, a printing released at one time.

clue.text: Indicated substance on middle of fern, cutting plant

indicators.note: middle of keeps just the central letters of the word that follows
on joins the word for substance to the letters after it
cutting means slicing into the plant, so the pieces go inside it

blocks.note: the gist is the substance or essence of something
the two inner letters of fern
a reed is a tall waterside grass

explanation.surface: A botanist's note about some substance on a fern frond damaging another plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A gauge or meter that registered a reading indicated it, so the two past tenses match.

clue.text: In solitaire get nice round number

indicators.note: In says the letters sit inside the run of words that follows
round means turned about, so the letters are read backwards

blocks.note: the letters span the end of solitaire, all of get and the start of nice

explanation.surface: A card player is pleased to get a nice round figure in a game of patience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round number' looks like the definition, but round is the turnaround signal and number alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: An integer is a whole number, with no fractional or decimal part.

clue.text: Curving in a circle around church

indicators.note: around says the circle encloses the abbreviation for church

blocks.note: taken as written
a ring is a circle
CH is the standard abbreviation for church

explanation.surface: Describes a curved path running round a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Arching describes bending into the shape of an arch, a curve like a bow.

clue.text: Quantity in map on distribution of bees around west in children's book

indicators.note: in places the word for quantity inside the word for map
on joins the first part to what follows it
a distribution spreads things out, so the letters are scattered and rearranged
around says the rearranged letters wrap the abbreviation for west

blocks.note: a lot is a quantity, as in a job lot
a chart is a map, especially a sea map
these letters are rearranged
W is the compass abbreviation for west

explanation.surface: A map plots how many bees are spread around to the west, like a nature survey.
explanation.walkthrough: The bees fit the book's farmyard world, where a spider spins words into her web.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlotte's Web is E. B. White's 1952 children's novel about a pig saved by a spider.

clue.text: Introductory remarks from peer, similar in broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered widely, like seed, so the letters are thrown into a new order

blocks.note: these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lord makes some opening remarks in a similar style on air.
explanation.definitionFit: Preliminaries are the opening matters or remarks that come before the main business.

clue.text: Revolutionary appeal in line deserving praise

indicators.note: in places the first two pieces inside the word for line

blocks.note: red is the colour of revolutionaries and communists
it means sex appeal, as in the it girl
a cable is a line, wire or rope

explanation.surface: A revolutionary's call to fall in line is commended.
explanation.definitionFit: Something creditable brings credit to its doer, so it is worthy of praise or respect.

clue.text: Reconfigured base conserving energy

indicators.note: conserving means keeping safe inside, so the base holds the energy letter

blocks.note: a rest is a support or base, as in an armrest
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An eco-friendly makeover of a building's foundations to save power.
explanation.definitionFit: To reset a device is to set it up again, restoring or changing its settings, so reconfigured.

clue.text: Question about husband with name in claim

indicators.note: with simply attaches the next piece alongside
in puts the abbreviation for name inside the word for claim

blocks.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about
H is the abbreviation for husband
to allege is to claim without proof
N is the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: A wife queries what her husband said about a name in some claim.
explanation.definitionFit: To challenge a statement is to dispute it, calling it into question.

clue.text: Shared nothing expert raised in case

indicators.note: in a down entry, raised means lifted upwards, so the pieces read from bottom to top
in places the turned pieces inside the word for case

blocks.note: O looks like zero, nothing
a pro is a professional, an expert
a crate is a packing case

explanation.surface: Suggests an expert who shared nothing in a legal case was brought up.
explanation.definitionFit: Corporate can mean shared by a whole group as one body, as in corporate responsibility.

clue.text: Release inspector's accusation

blocks.note: DI is a Detective Inspector, and the 's is added
a charge is a formal accusation of a crime

explanation.surface: A police inspector's charge leads to someone being freed.
explanation.walkthrough: DI is the British police rank of Detective Inspector.
explanation.definitionFit: To discharge someone is to release them, as from hospital, the army or custody.

clue.text: Played leading role and looked about right

indicators.note: about means the word for looked goes round the abbreviation for right

blocks.note: stared means looked fixedly
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: An actor took the lead role and kept glancing about to the right.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor who starred in a film had the leading role in it.

clue.text: Tent torn initially by sword

indicators.note: initially keeps only the opening letter of the word before it
by places the next piece beside the first

blocks.note: the first letter of torn
an epee is a fencing sword

explanation.surface: A tent was ripped open by a sword at the start of an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: A tepee is a conical tent of skins or canvas used by Plains peoples of North America.

clue.text: Father with odd items required for hobby

indicators.note: odd means strange or out of order, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: pa is an informal word for father
these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Dad needs a collection of odd bits and pieces for his hobby.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastime is an activity that passes the time pleasantly, a hobby or recreation.

clue.text: King in end has got son prepared? What a relief

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, worked into shape, so the letters are reworked
in puts the chess abbreviation for king inside the rearranged letters

blocks.note: K is the abbreviation for king
these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A king, at the end, is relieved that his son is ready to succeed.
explanation.definitionFit: Thank goodness is an exclamation of relief, used just like what a relief.

clue.text: Expression of surprise, following tips for divine colour scheme

indicators.note: tips are the two ends, so only the outer letters of the next word are kept
following puts the exclamation after the kept letters

blocks.note: the first and last letters of divine
cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like wow

explanation.surface: Someone gasps in admiration at a divine colour scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: Cor is a British slang exclamation of amazement.
explanation.definitionFit: Decor is a room's decoration and furnishing style, chiefly its colour scheme.

clue.text: Guard, rising, giving sly look

indicators.note: in a down entry, rising means read upwards, so the word goes backwards

blocks.note: to keep is to guard or protect

explanation.surface: A sentry stands up and steals a sideways glance.
explanation.definitionFit: A peek is a quick, furtive glance, a sly little look.

clue.text: Prohibition as it affected coffee shop worker

indicators.note: affected means altered or disturbed, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: a bar is a ban or prohibition
these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A ban hits a café employee where it hurts.
explanation.definitionFit: A barista is someone who makes and serves coffee drinks in a café.

clue.text: Assist in scripting ceremony after scare

indicators.note: after places the word for ceremony behind the word for scare

blocks.note: to cow is to intimidate or frighten into submission
a rite is a ceremony

explanation.surface: Someone helps write the script for a ritual after a fright.
explanation.definitionFit: To co-write is to share in writing something, so to assist with a script.

clue.text: Aims for extremities

blocks.note: first meaning: goals, as in means to an end
second meaning: the far points or tips of something

explanation.walkthrough: It reads like aiming at hands and feet; the two words are separate meanings of one short noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Ends can be purposes or goals, and also the farthest points or limits of a thing.

clue.text: Trauma? Pay attention to temperature and rest

blocks.note: to hear is to listen, paying attention
T is the abbreviation for temperature
a break is a rest or pause

explanation.surface: Advice after a trauma: listen to your body's temperature and get some rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartbreak is overwhelming grief or emotional distress, a kind of emotional trauma.
